## Documentation

- [ ] Current behavior and future behavior are clearly distinguished.
- [ ] Affected specifications and ADRs are updated together.
- [ ] Relative links and changed-file scope were checked.
- [ ] No secret, credential, private URL, or sensitive report detail is included.

## Completion checklist

- [ ] The change is one scoped feature or documentation outcome.
- [ ] Failure paths and security boundaries are addressed where applicable.
- [ ] Public interfaces were not silently changed.
- [ ] Relevant automated or scaffold tests pass, and any absent product-test layer is stated explicitly.
- [ ] `blueprint.md` is unchanged unless the review explicitly scopes a vision amendment.
- [ ] Known limitations and remaining tasks are listed without placeholder markers.
